_comment: Mastery ledger for the progressive-exam tutor. Claude reads this at the start of every session and updates it at the end. Status flow per rung: locked -> unlocked -> mastered. A topic is mastered only when its final rung is mastered. Do NOT start a topic until all its prerequisites are mastered. Ramp length = D + 1 (rungs). Rung goals: 1=concept recognition, 2=guided application, mid=partial exam, last=full exam.
ramp_rule: New topics open with first contact (Problematic -> hook -> [Probe] ungraded -> [Worked example] faded) BEFORE rung 1. Then rungs = difficulty_d + 1; rung1=concept recognition (mcq/short), rung2=guided application (skeleton given), middle=partial exam (skeleton removed, hint on failure-mode), last=full exam-format question, no scaffold.
mastery_rule: Advance a rung only on a passing graded answer: >=85% of marks AND no fatal conceptual error (final rung >=90%). A fatal error fails the answer at any score. Two consecutive fails on a rung -> drop one rung; at rung 1 -> fuller worked example instead. Topic mastered only when final rung mastered.

exam_prep._comment: State for the fast exam-prep mode (/start-session, /session-end, /mock-exam). ADDITIVE and self-contained: this mode never writes topics[], status, rung, current_rung, rung_status, attempts[], exam_coverage, next_session, review_queue or session_log - those belong to the deep-mode tutor. `exam_ready` and `mastered` are different criteria and are never conflated: mastered = unaided 90% on an exam-format question; exam_ready = 2 consecutive clean drills inside budget.
